# CORRECTED_PIN_MAPPING (generated by Hardware/build/audit_pins.py)

Columns: PCB pad = pad number and net read from NIGHTHAWK.kicad_pcb via pcbnew; symbol = pin function in the schematic library symbol; datasheet = function in the named document; firmware = define in Firmware/include/pins.h compared by number.

Result per pin is PASS only if (datasheet function, symbol function and PCB net are consistent with the design intent in design.py) and, where applicable, the firmware define equals the physical GPIO/expander bit.
